newsitem.title: USA: Atlas Air sees Q2 below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Air sees Q2 below expectations.

text.p: Atlas Air Inc said it expects its second quarter results to be below current analyst expectations.
It said that in conjunction with its recently-announced order for 747-400 aircraft from Boeing Co, it will write off its remaining investment in five Federal Express aircraft.

Atlas said the after-tax impact of various non-recurring charges could approximate $17 million, due to the write-off of leasehold improvements associated with its acquisition of the five 747-200s from Federal Express, reserves for costs necessary to return aircraft at the end of their leases, and charges for the establishment of reserves for future periods.

The company said the charges will be balanced out by an extraordinary after-tax gain of about $16.6 million from the receipt of a prepayment incentive credit associated with refinancing about $235 million of indebtedness.

Atlas said that although these items are principally one-time and non-recurring, their impact coupled with higher than expected costs and lower revenues associated with the operational limitations of the five Federal Express aircraft, will cause the company's results for the quarter to be below analyst expectations.
